integrity: Exact angular rank-two proof with standard-library finite symbolic checks; verification is same-model review, not independent confirmation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The proof assumes a single analytic monomial, the unit disk and beta-weighted area measure with alpha>-1; nonmonomial symbols and arbitrary radial weights are not covered. Historical priority is not exhaustively verified because a plausible 2021 source could not be inspected in full.
title: Signed spectral decomposition of monomial dual Toeplitz self-commutators on weighted harmonic Bergman complements
